column1: # Iliad - Part 1.5 — naskah sisi E99004: Florence memimpin tim penyelamat garis depan.
# Tetap Inggris: Florence, Cheyanne, Klukai, Zhaohui, Colphne, Mayling, Helena, Melanie,
# Mokosh, Paradajz, Oathguard, Squad 404, The Elmo, Doll, Neural cloud, UL-AP, CIWS.
Ugh... R-Report... Close-in... weapon system 4 destroyed.
column2: Ugh... L-Lapor... Sistem senjata... jarak dekat 4 hancur.

column1: Squad... unresponsive... Ugh...
column2: Regu... tidak merespons... Ugh...

column1: (On the scorched earth filled with gunpowder smoke, a Mokosh Oathguard soldier is struggling to lean against the remains of a cover. One of his hands tightly covers his continuously bleeding neck, while the other hand shakily taps on his communication terminal. His heavy, broken gasping is exceptionally jarring on the dead-silent battlefield.)
column2: (Di tanah hangus yang dipenuhi asap mesiu, seorang prajurit Oathguard Mokosh berjuang menyandarkan diri pada sisa perlindungan. Satu tangannya menekan erat lehernya yang terus berdarah, sementara tangan lainnya gemetar mengetuk terminal komunikasinya. Embusan napasnya yang berat dan putus-putus terdengar sangat mengiris di medan tempur yang sunyi bagai kematian itu.)

column1: Command Center... please respond if you hear this... ugh...
column2: Pusat Komando... tolong jawab kalau mendengar ini... ugh...

column1: (The ruthless electronic busy tone from the communicator was like a countdown to a death sentence. The Oathguard soldier looked up and let out a long, despairing sigh.)
column2: (Nada sibuk elektronik yang tak berperasaan dari komunikator itu bagai hitung mundur vonis mati. Prajurit Oathguard itu mendongak dan mengembuskan napas panjang penuh keputusasaan.)

column1: Communications are jammed... It seems rescue is hopeless...
column2: Komunikasinya diganggu... Sepertinya tidak ada harapan diselamatkan...

column1: We promised... after this battle, we'd go try Paradajz's newest tomato smoothie flavor together.
column2: Kita sudah berjanji... setelah pertempuran ini, kita akan mencoba rasa terbaru smoothie tomat Paradajz bersama-sama.

column1: In the end... I'm the only one left here...
column2: Pada akhirnya... cuma aku yang tersisa di sini...

column1: (The extreme cold brought on by blood loss invaded his entire body, and the soldier's vision was gradually swallowed by scarlet and darkness. His fingers, which had been pressing tightly against his wound, lost their strength and slowly slipped away.)
column2: (Dingin yang teramat sangat akibat kehabisan darah menyerbu seluruh tubuhnya, dan pandangan prajurit itu perlahan ditelan warna merah tua dan kegelapan. Jarinya yang tadi menekan erat lukanya kehilangan tenaga dan perlahan meluncur lepas.)

column1: (However, in this near-death moment, a seemingly slender yet exceptionally strong hand precisely clamped his wrist, pressing tightly against the wound once again.)
column2: (Namun di detik-detik menjelang ajal itu, sebuah tangan yang tampak ramping tapi luar biasa kuat tepat mencengkeram pergelangannya, kembali menekan lukanya erat-erat.)

column1: Mhm, you pressed the neck wound in time to stop the bleeding. It seems you learned the previous battlefield self-rescue training very well.
column2: Mhm, kau menekan luka lehermu tepat waktu untuk menghentikan pendarahan. Sepertinya kau belajar dengan baik di latihan pertolongan diri di medan tempur kemarin.

column1: Come, let me see...
column2: Sini, coba kulihat...

column1: You are... that Commander's medical...
column2: Anda... medis milik Komandan itu...

column1: Shh, don't speak, save your strength... you'll have plenty of time later to lie comfortably in a hospital bed and chat.
column2: Sst, jangan bicara, hemat tenagamu... nanti kau punya banyak waktu untuk berbaring nyaman di ranjang rumah sakit sambil mengobrol.

column1: Keep pressing, I'll have it bandaged right away.
column2: Terus ditekan, sebentar lagi kubalut.

column1: (Florence's pupils flashed several times, quickly locking onto the patient's condition through her visual module. In just an instant, she had already finished bandaging the wounded.)
column2: (Pupil Florence berkedip beberapa kali, cepat mengunci kondisi pasiennya lewat modul penglihatannya. Hanya dalam sekejap, dia sudah selesai membalut korban itu.)

column1: Team 1, you guys take this wounded person back first.
column2: Tim 1, kalian bawa korban ini pulang duluan.

column1: There are still a few soldiers with weak vital signs under the ruins... I need stretchers and a large amount of gauze, move fast!
column2: Masih ada beberapa prajurit dengan tanda vital lemah di bawah reruntuhan... Aku butuh tandu dan kain kasa dalam jumlah banyak, cepat!

column1: Eh... they... actually still have people alive...
column2: Eh... mereka... ternyata masih ada yang hidup...

column1: Didn't I say it already? You'll have plenty of time to talk later. Hurry up and transfer.
column2: Bukankah sudah kubilang? Nanti kau punya banyak waktu untuk bicara. Cepat pindahkan.

column1: (Without any hesitation, Florence handed the bandaged soldier over to the arriving human medics, turned around, and darted through the ruins like a lithe cheetah.)
column2: (Tanpa ragu sedikit pun, Florence menyerahkan prajurit yang sudah dibalut itu kepada tenaga medis manusia yang datang, berbalik, lalu melesat menembus reruntuhan bagai citah yang lentur.)

column1: (Soon she found a severely injured, bloodied Oathguard. The vital signs monitoring system of Florence's visual module scanned the wounded's body, and a precise rescue plan was already generated in her Neural cloud.)
column2: (Tak lama dia menemukan seorang Oathguard yang terluka parah dan berlumuran darah. Sistem pemantau tanda vital di modul penglihatan Florence memindai tubuh korban itu, dan rencana penyelamatan yang presisi langsung tersusun di Neural cloud-nya.)

column1: Head hit by metal shrapnel on the right lower jaw... comminuted fracture of the mandible, severe laceration causing massive hemorrhage.
column2: Kepala terkena serpihan logam di rahang bawah kanan... patah remuk pada mandibula, robekan parah menyebabkan pendarahan hebat.

column1: Open fracture of the left forearm... bone exposed. Numerous non-penetrating wounds on the chest and abdomen. Also, a severe penetrating wound on the left thigh...
column2: Patah terbuka pada lengan bawah kiri... tulang terekspos. Banyak luka tidak tembus di dada dan perut. Juga luka tembus parah di paha kiri...

column1: For the penetrating wound on the thigh, immediately inject UL-AP medical gel along with gauze deep into the wound to stop the bleeding! Leave the neck and chest wounds to me.
column2: Untuk luka tembus di paha, segera suntikkan gel medis UL-AP bersama kasa jauh ke dalam luka untuk menghentikan pendarahan! Luka leher dan dada serahkan padaku.

column1: Stretchers! Notify the underground bunker to prepare for emergency surgery!
column2: Tandu! Beritahu bunker bawah tanah untuk menyiapkan operasi darurat!

column1: (Within ten minutes while the smoke still hasn't cleared, this white figure is exceptionally conspicuous over the ruins.)
column2: (Dalam sepuluh menit selagi asapnya belum sirna, sosok berbaju putih itu sangat mencolok di atas reruntuhan.)

column1: (Florence, with almost insane efficiency, forcibly dragged all the survivors of close-in weapon system 4 back from death's door.)
column2: (Dengan efisiensi yang nyaris gila, Florence menyeret paksa semua penyintas sistem senjata jarak dekat 4 kembali dari pintu kematian.)

column1: Close-in weapon system 4 has 6 survivors. I have already synced their initial triage files to you. Let the doctors down below handle the subsequent debridement and suturing.
column2: Sistem senjata jarak dekat 4 punya 6 penyintas. Berkas triase awal mereka sudah kukirim padamu. Biar dokter di bawah yang menangani pembersihan luka dan penjahitannya.

column1: Transport this last wounded person back too, someone will cover you.
column2: Korban terakhir ini juga diangkut pulang, akan ada yang melindungi kalian.

column1: After that, follow the marks I left to find the wounded I've treated and transport them back to Mokosh.
column2: Setelah itu, ikuti tanda yang kutinggalkan untuk menemukan korban yang sudah kutangani dan bawa mereka kembali ke Mokosh.

column1: Little Cheyanne, did you hear me?
column2: Cheyanne kecil, kau dengar?

column1: The retreat route has been secured, I will provide cover.
column2: Jalur mundurnya sudah diamankan, aku yang akan melindungi.

column1: But, aren't you evacuating with the medical team?
column2: Tapi, bukankah kau menyingkir bersama tim medis?

column1: Just now, the No. 6 close-in weapon system was attacked by a suicide drone swarm and has completely lost contact.
column2: Barusan sistem senjata jarak dekat No. 6 diserang kawanan drone bunuh diri dan hilang kontak sepenuhnya.

column1: And there are three squads that sent weak distress signals on the public frequency. I have to rush over there first to give them an "emergency treatment".
column2: Dan ada tiga regu yang mengirim sinyal darurat lemah di frekuensi umum. Aku harus ke sana dulu untuk memberi mereka "penanganan darurat".

column1: But you're all alone...
column2: Tapi kau sendirian...

column1: Furthermore, the No. 6 CIWS is on the edge of the outermost firing line. Once you're there, I won't be able to provide you with effective cover.
column2: Lagi pula CIWS No. 6 ada di tepi garis tembak terluar. Begitu kau di sana, aku tidak akan bisa memberimu perlindungan yang efektif.

column1: Oh my~ Is little Cheyanne worrying about me~
column2: Aduh~ Cheyanne kecil mencemaskanku ya~

column1: Don't worry, I like this thrilling experience of dancing on the tip of a knife the most.
column2: Tenang saja, aku paling suka sensasi menegangkan menari di ujung pisau begini.

column1: Little Klukai, can you provide a round of smoke cover on my advance route?
column2: Klukai kecil, bisa beri satu ronde tabir asap di rute majuku?

column1: Don't call me by that disgusting nickname.
column2: Jangan panggil aku dengan panggilan menjijikkan itu.

column1: Smoke grenades will arrive in 30 seconds, Zhaohui and the others will also provide cover.
column2: Granat asap tiba dalam 30 detik, Zhaohui dan yang lain juga akan melindungi.

column1: Keep yourself safe. You're the frontline rescue captain personally appointed by the Commander, don't die too ugly a death.
column2: Jaga keselamatanmu. Kau kapten tim penyelamat garis depan yang ditunjuk langsung Komandan, jangan mati dengan cara yang terlalu jelek.

column1: Haha, true indeed~ So I will take this mission very seriously.
column2: Haha, benar juga~ Makanya misi ini akan kuanggap serius sekali.

column1: After all, it's been a long time since I saw the Commander ask me so earnestly~
column2: Lagi pula sudah lama aku tidak melihat Komandan meminta padaku dengan setulus itu~

column1: Oh my, Commander, suddenly calling me alone to the command center~ Could it be that the Commander knows I newly formulated some mood-enhancing incense and wants to find some excitement~
column2: Aduh, Komandan, tiba-tiba memanggilku sendirian ke pusat komando~ Jangan-jangan Komandan tahu aku baru meracik dupa penambah mood dan mau cari sensasi~

column1: Florence, I need you to take the lead in forming a frontline mobile rescue team.
column2: Florence, aku butuh kau memimpin pembentukan tim penyelamat bergerak di garis depan.

column1: This war is already unavoidable, but I still want to do my utmost to reduce everyone's casualties as much as possible.
column2: Perang ini sudah tidak terhindarkan, tapi aku tetap ingin berusaha sekuat tenaga menekan korban di pihak kita sebanyak mungkin.

column1: Ah mhm~ Since it's a personal request from the Commander, I'll rarely be a little more serious.
column2: Ah mhm~ Karena ini permintaan pribadi dari Komandan, sekali-sekali aku akan sedikit lebih serius.

column1: What exactly do you need me to do?
column2: Apa persisnya yang Komandan butuhkan dariku?

column1: I will arrange for Squad 404 and Cheyanne to intercept the enemy elites in the ruins on the outskirts of Mokosh. This should suppress the direct casualty rate of human soldiers.
column2: Aku akan mengatur Squad 404 dan Cheyanne untuk mencegat pasukan elite musuh di reruntuhan pinggiran Mokosh. Itu seharusnya menekan angka korban langsung di kalangan prajurit manusia.

column1: However, the close-in weapon systems, bunker fortifications... and large-scale tactical penetrations still require the human soldiers of Mokosh to fill with their lives.
column2: Tapi sistem senjata jarak dekat, benteng bunker... dan penerobosan taktis berskala besar tetap harus diisi prajurit manusia Mokosh dengan nyawa mereka.

column1: Mokosh doesn't lack good doctors who can perform surgeries in sterile rooms, but it lacks people who can weave through heavy artillery fire, provide emergency treatment for the severely wounded, and bring them back alive.
column2: Mokosh tidak kekurangan dokter bagus yang bisa mengoperasi di ruang steril, tapi kekurangan orang yang bisa menyusup di antara gempuran artileri berat, memberi penanganan darurat pada korban luka parah, dan membawa mereka pulang hidup-hidup.

column1: So this time, I'm handing over all the arrangements for frontline rescue entirely to you. You can deploy any resources you want, and other squads will also provide you with support.
column2: Karena itu kali ini, seluruh pengaturan penyelamatan garis depan kuserahkan sepenuhnya padamu. Kau boleh mengerahkan sumber daya apa pun, dan regu lain juga akan mendukungmu.

column1: This really is an exciting and highly valuable mission.
column2: Ini benar-benar misi yang menegangkan sekaligus sangat berharga.

column1: So the priority of the mission is~
column2: Jadi prioritas misinya~

column1: I'll leave it to your judgment.
column2: Kuserahkan pada penilaianmu.

column1: Although you often play pranks and act without any taboos on ordinary days, in terms of medical treatment, you always maintain the purest respect for life.
column2: Meski di hari biasa kau sering iseng dan bertindak tanpa pantangan, dalam urusan pengobatan kau selalu menjaga rasa hormat yang paling murni pada kehidupan.

column1: So on this point, I trust you unconditionally.
column2: Jadi soal itu, aku memercayaimu tanpa syarat.

column1: I will transfer Colphne over too, and let her cooperate with you...
column2: Aku akan memindahkan Colphne ke sana juga, biar dia bekerja sama denganmu...

column1: That won't do.
column2: Itu tidak boleh.

column1: Little Colphne must stay on The Elmo, or follow closely by your side, Commander.
column2: Colphne kecil harus tetap di Elmo, atau mengikuti rapat di sisi Komandan.

column1: ...Tell me your reason.
column2: ...Katakan alasanmu.

column1: As a doctor, I think little Mayling, little Helena, and little Melanie all need a reliable doctor to look after them at all times.
column2: Sebagai dokter, kurasa Mayling kecil, Helena kecil, dan Melanie kecil sama-sama butuh dokter yang bisa diandalkan untuk mengawasi mereka setiap saat.

column1: As a tactical Doll, I think the one who most needs to be secured in this battle is you, Commander~
column2: Sebagai Doll taktis, kurasa yang paling perlu diamankan dalam pertempuran ini adalah Komandan sendiri~

column1: As for personally~ The Commander asked me so seriously, how could I possibly share such an exciting thing with little Colphne~
column2: Kalau secara pribadi~ Komandan meminta padaku dengan begitu serius, mana mungkin aku membagi hal seseru ini dengan Colphne kecil~

column1: Don't worry, Mokosh's medics are also very reliable. They just need to follow me to do emergency treatment on the battlefield and help me transport the wounded back to the operating table. The rest can be left to Mokosh's local doctors to handle.
column2: Tenang, tenaga medis Mokosh juga sangat bisa diandalkan. Mereka cukup mengikutiku melakukan penanganan darurat di medan tempur dan membantuku mengangkut korban ke meja operasi. Sisanya bisa diserahkan pada dokter lokal Mokosh.

column1: I respect your judgment, but... absolutely don't act recklessly.
column2: Aku menghormati penilaianmu, tapi... sama sekali jangan bertindak nekat.

column1: Although I promised the Commander at the time that I wouldn't act recklessly... but these guys opposite have even brought out special anti-Doll ammunition.
column2: Meski waktu itu aku berjanji pada Komandan tidak akan bertindak nekat... tapi orang-orang di seberang sana bahkan mengeluarkan amunisi khusus anti-Doll.

column1: Oh my, oh my... it seems I can only act a little "recklessly".
column2: Aduh, aduh... sepertinya aku terpaksa bertindak sedikit "nekat".
